notes: Local fixtures only. Copy TES-Tube to a scratch dir, apply the fixture patch (kept outside this public repo because it touches client source) (neutral Uzbek channel names, titles and comments in place of the Figma-copied ones), then `next build` in apps/web with NEXT_PUBLIC_USE_MOCK_DATA=true and serve .next/standalone/apps/web/server.js on PORT=3217. Player close-ups come from specs/tes-tube-player.json (1360x850 so the settings menu reads larger). mobile-01..03 are 430x873 iPhone 14 Pro Max emulation shots of / , /watch/vid-fond-bozori (gear opens the quality sheet) and /shorts, each with a 177px status-bar band added on top, saved via save-images.mjs --kind=mobile.
